segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Hello, thank you for calling Acme Support. My name is Priya. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Priya. I'm having trouble logging into my account. I've tried resetting my password three times but I keep getting an error.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you please confirm the email address associated with your account?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you. I can see your account. It looks like it was temporarily locked due to multiple failed login attempts. Let me unlock it for you.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh, that would be great. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Done. I've unlocked your account and sent a password reset link to your email. Please check your inbox and spam folder.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it, I see the email. I'll try resetting now... Yes, it worked! I'm logged in now.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Wonderful. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that's all. Thanks for your help!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're welcome. Have a great day!
